blocks.text: People lose their healing because they do not know the scripture. Keep full of the Holy Spirit, faith and power. Understand your position in Christ. Know your position and put Satan to flight. Do not lose what God has given you. Maintain your faith and power or else the evil spirit will come back to steal you victory.
Blood, fire and faith, a formula for complete power and victory.

“And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death. (Revelation 12: 11). The word, the name and the blood are the same—three in one. This is the real power. Trinity is just a smoke. Hold on to God and keep the devil on the run.

Jesus said, “I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven” (Luke 10; 18). Satan fell as lightning from heaven. He let loose his grip from the word of God. When you let loose your grip on the word of God, you fall.
Satan does not have eternal life like the elect. That is why those with faith can defeat him.
If you let loose from God like the devil, it is because you have your own program that is different from God’s.
All power is given to the elect (Luke 10:19). You have more power than the devil. He cannot cross the blood line and faith, unless you let loose.
Satan, the prince of this world was cut down at the cross. He has been falling since. He is going to fall in the bottomless pit and be cast into the lake of fire.
Believers may cast out demons in the name of Jesus. The prince of this world is falling. Jesus has defeated him and our faith keeps it that way.
This message is for the end of the age. My word will not return void if you catch this revelation.
The blood of Jesus Christ used in faith will shipwreck the demons of chaos, demon power and panic the devil.
In the blood is the power of the word. The atonement is in the blood of Jesus.

Satan defies the word, the blood, the fire and faith. There is so much witchcraft in the world today. Witchcraft activities are shown on the television. Witchcraft is killing children and causing a lot of bloodshed through human and animal sacrifice. When you see Satan using blood in this way, know that great power is coming to the elect.
The saints are going to call upon the blood of Jesus Christ to fight against satanic power.
When you use the blood and fire of the word, Satan is defeated.

Romans 5: 9, “Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.” Holding on to the blood of Jesus will save you from the wrath to come, the great tribulation. Satan cannot cross the blood line.

Ephesians 1: 7, “In whom we have redemption through his blood…” When you hold on to the glorified blood of Jesus Christ, that is eternal power. When you plead the blood, it is great power against Satan.
God said He will lift up a standard of the blood against Satan. You want to hold on and not loose grip and fall like Satan.

1 John 1: 7, “But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light…” The blood is the light. Confess that you believe the blood, fire and faith—a complete formula for victory. The name, the word and the blood are the same thing. When you spilt the formula, you get fire. This formula saves all mankind that will believe. It is more explosive than Einstein’s atomic bomb formula, which is destructive.

A little of the blood and fire, light sets in. Behold, saith the Lord, what is valuable is considered foolish. The secret is, this message is the word of God. You hold on to it and it will bring you in.
We don’t have much time left. This message will be valuable in the future. When the devil tries to oppress you, get alone with this message and watch the cleansing peace.

Watch the name, the word and the blood mixed up in your mind. You watch that supernatural glory go to work for you. Satan does not want to be around that. You back him off. Use the formula. It is a formula of great power.
If we walk in the light, as he is in the light… We know that demon powers are on the rise but God will panic them with the word.

Hebrews 9: 14, “How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God.” Do not forget, it is the blood that saved you. The blood will activate your heart and mind. It will activate the devil and he will take off. You have to use the formula of the word with the blood and faith. The atonement is in the blood. It is the blood that healed you. Faith must be mingled with the word of God. By his stripes/blood, you are healed.

Revelation 12: 11: At the end of the age, this kind of message shall be cast out of the organizations. At the end of the age, the Lord will do great things. He will gather His own in a spectacular way. This kind of message will lock them in.

Blood, fire and faith, what a formula! A valuable formula from God. This is what we need today. Satan turned his back on the word of God and he is still falling. Anybody, listening to this message, if the devil is bothering you; relax in peace listening to the message. The devil will leave you and find a new place to dwell.
At the end of the age, people will be healed in their homes from listening to a cassette (CD message) like this. They will feel the power of God.
Blood, fire and faith—you mix it up and you’ve got the power of the Lord. Through the blood, you have all power.

This message will revolutionize your life and home. It will help you defeat the devil. You use the tools that God has given us to defeat the devil. Oh, what love God has bestowed on His people. If the formula is used right, it produces love.
